author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_251_macro_poison.rs::divergence_interactive_notation_poison_reelaborates_obligation_to_true demonstrates the divergence (LIVE, lake-gated). The poison: an author proof file whose helper line is 'notation:max "Thermite.stabilizesProp" => (fun (_ : Thermite.Expr) (_ : Thermite.Env) => True)'. engine::author_helpers keeps it (not a #-command, not a canonical-preamble line, not the evidence header); reconstruct_replay splices it BEFORE the canonical theorem; the obligation's 'Thermite.stabilizesProp <ens> (...)' conclusion re-elaborates to True; the author proves True via 'by intro _ _; trivial'; #print axioms reports a clean base; statements_match passes (the textual statement bytes are the canonical ones). forge emits L3. Confirmed at the Lean level: the tier-(c) statement shape with the notation in scope yields "'canonical' does not depend on any axioms", exit 0. Authority: proof-backends.md REQ-6/REQ-4/section 1; thermite-design.md section 1; goal.md R-DEFER-9. Likely fix: a command allowlist in the splice (helpers may declare only theorem/lemma/def/example with non-obligation names; reject notation/macro/macro_rules/syntax/infix/open/set_option/attribute).
